responsibility: Implements the core D statement AST classes and their shared behavior. The file defines construction, copying, pretty-printing, diagnostics, control-flow queries, and concrete node mechanics for compound blocks, labels, gotos, inline and GCC asm, imports, and other statement forms that semantic analysis and lowering transform later.
same_name_distinction: Provides the out-of-line behavior for the statement AST declared in gcc/d/dmd/statement.h, including shared Statement utilities and concrete node methods such as syntax copying, flattening, diagnostics, and goto/label and asm statement mechanics. It is the implementation companion to the header’s class and enum definitions.
